title: Illumination of Scripture
definition: Illumination is the work of the Holy Spirit that enables believers to understand, receive, and apply the truth of Scripture.
summary: The Holy Spirit does not give new revelation apart from Scripture. Instead, He helps believers understand what God has already revealed and empowers them to respond in faith and obedience.
christFocus: The Holy Spirit glorifies Christ. Through illumination, believers see Christ more clearly in Scripture and grow in their knowledge and love of Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Understanding Scripture is ultimately a spiritual work. Knowledge alone is not enough; believers need the Spirit's help to grasp God's truth.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Bible study should never become merely academic. The goal is transformation, not simply information.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Pray before reading Scripture. Ask the Holy Spirit to teach, convict, encourage, and strengthen you through God's Word.
